contradictions.what: Rep says nothing got silence and it was a good cycle, yet customer questions shifted from declines to only rate.
Rep says lost on price, but also says matching price might not be enough (IT timing, same-rate page).
Rep said Lucy was sold and no value figure was needed, but Lucy asked for a business case and Martin had nothing quantifying cost.
Rep names Martin as decider but never met him and wasn't in the room; the decision account is entirely secondhand.
Lucy called the approval a formality right before Martin rejected it, undercutting the rep's read of champion strength.
Rep says 'same thing' isn't true but never put the differences (gateway fee, chargebacks) in front of Martin.

dodges.what: Answered with the generic uplift slide before admitting no Fernbrook figure.
